BackstoryDef.title: Shelter Child
BackstoryDef.description: [PAWN_nameDef] spent [PAWN_possessive] childhood in the deep shelters under Anima Prime, where the ceiling shook on a schedule and the adults counted the intervals out loud. [PAWN_pronoun] learned to read a bombardment the way other children learn weather.

BackstoryDef.title: Bloodline Ward
BackstoryDef.description: Artillery had already taken most of [PAWN_nameDef]'s family line before [PAWN_pronoun] was old enough to know what a bloodline was. The relatives who remained were catalogued, scattered to separate postings, and raised at the Mage Tower's expense.

BackstoryDef.title: Range Runner
BackstoryDef.description: [PAWN_nameDef] grew up on the edge of a live-fire range, running spent brass and message slips between the firing lines for pocket money. [PAWN_pronoun] could name a weapon by its report long before [PAWN_pronoun] was allowed to hold one.

BackstoryDef.title: Reservist Caster
BackstoryDef.description: [PAWN_nameDef] was born in a city-state under offworlder occupation. Once [PAWN_pronoun] tested for strong psychic affinity [PAWN_possessive] tuition was covered in full, and [PAWN_pronoun] left school commissioned as a reserve non-commissioned officer.

BackstoryDef.title: Wreck Picker
BackstoryDef.description: [PAWN_nameDef] made a childhood out of other people's destroyed equipment, prising stamped components out of burnt-out frames and selling them by weight. [PAWN_pronoun] came away knowing exactly how a machine goes together - and, more usefully, exactly where it comes apart.

BackstoryDef.title: Retired Medic
BackstoryDef.description: [PAWN_nameDef] served as a medic in the Armed Forces, until a serious injury ended [PAWN_possessive] service early.

BackstoryDef.title: Line Magier
BackstoryDef.description: [PAWN_nameDef] spent [PAWN_possessive] service attached to line infantry, bleeding for the nation [PAWN_pronoun] served alongside tactical casters of [PAWN_possessive] own generation.

BackstoryDef.title: Assault Engineer
BackstoryDef.description: [PAWN_nameDef] was trained to take structures apart - charges when there was time, bare psychic force when there was not. Breaching walls and disabling emplacements became second nature.

BackstoryDef.title: Breach Magier
BackstoryDef.description: [PAWN_nameDef] went through doorways first, for years. Flash, two steps, rifle up before anyone inside had their eyes back. The doctrine is not complicated and it does not forgive hesitation.

BackstoryDef.title: Construct Wright
BackstoryDef.description: [PAWN_nameDef] fought a war largely by proxy, condensing entropy into crystal and framing it around whatever stamped parts were to hand. [PAWN_possessive] section learned to judge how the fight was going by how many constructs were still standing.

BackstoryDef.title: Countermech Specialist
BackstoryDef.description: [PAWN_nameDef] was posted where the mechanoids came through, twisting the field lines into pulses that left whole formations reeling. Nobody ever thanked [PAWN_pronoun] for it, because nobody ever saw the fight [PAWN_pronoun] prevented.

BackstoryDef.title: Long Watch
BackstoryDef.description: [PAWN_nameDef] held observation posts alone for stretches no unaugmented soldier could manage, forcing [PAWN_possessive] own brain awake shift after shift. The neural heat accumulated. So did the habit of talking to nobody.

BackstoryDef.title: Cloaked Scout
BackstoryDef.description: Helmet and cloak together, [PAWN_nameDef] walked through positions that were certain they were secure. [PAWN_pronoun] reported what was there, and occasionally removed it, and was never once seen doing either.

BackstoryDef.title: Bodyguard Magier
BackstoryDef.description: [PAWN_nameDef] was assigned to keep a staff officer alive, which in practice meant standing close enough to trade places with [PAWN_objective] at a moment's notice. [PAWN_pronoun] did so twice. The officer survived both times.
